history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration carry out a thorough review of cost recovery in the cost-recovery fund (10RCR) to ensure its reasonableness.
history.administration_response: The Administration is preparing a report on cost recovery for the eightieth session of the General Assembly. The report will include a review of the cost recovery funds. In addition to this review, the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget has requested service providers with fund balances in excess of the one- year threshold to provide a medium-term plan detailing the fund balance requirements, including for staff liabilities, operating costs and capital expenditure.
history.board_assessment: Given that accumulated surpluses continue to increase and differences remain among the reserve ratios of entities, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 61 of its report, the Board recommended that the Administration carry out a thorough review of cost recovery in the cost-recovery fund (10 RCR) to ensure its reasonableness.
history.reference_raw: Report of the Board for the year ended 31 December 2019 5
history.entities_raw: Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance
history.sg_progress: The Administration’s efforts to address this recommendation in a timely manner have been affected by limited staffing and by competing priorities, especially with increased demands from oversight and legislative bodies and the expansion of cost- recovery activities. However, the Administration is preparing a report on cost recovery for presentation at the eightieth session of the General Assembly. The report will include a review of the cost-recovery funds. In addition to this review, the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance has requested service providers with fund balances in excess of the one-year threshold to provide a medium- term plan detailing the fund balance requirements, including for staff liabilities, operating costs and capital expenditures. Once the report is submitted to the Assembly, closure of the recommendation will be requested.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration carry out a thorough review of cost recovery in the cost-recovery fund (10RCR) to ensure its reasonableness.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. With the submission of the report of the Secretary-General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (A/80/369), the Administration addressed the Board’s findings and recommendation by providing details of the recommended thorough review of cost recovery carried out.
history.board_assessment: Given that the report of the Secretary-General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (A/80/369) has been submitted, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
